name: Crear o buscar sesión
query:
insert into public.candidate_sessions (
  telefono,
  current_step,
  data,
  last_message_id,
  last_interaction_at
)
values (
  $1,
  'bienvenida',
  '{}'::jsonb,
  $2,
  now()
)
on conflict (telefono) do update set
  last_message_id = excluded.last_message_id,
  last_interaction_at = now(),
  updated_at = now()
returning
  telefono,
  current_step,
  data,
  $2::text as message_id,
  $3::text as incoming_text,
  $4::text as message_type;

name: Guardar sesión
query:
update public.candidate_sessions
set
  current_step = $1,
  data = $2::jsonb,
  updated_at = now(),
  last_interaction_at = now()
where telefono = $3
returning *;

name: Leer memoria candidato
query:
select
  s.telefono,
  s.current_step,
  s.data,
  s.last_message_id,
  $2::text as incoming_text,
  $3::text as message_type,

  case
    when c.id is not null then true
    else false
  end as candidate_exists,

  to_jsonb(c) as candidate_profile

from public.candidate_sessions s
left join public.candidates c
  on c.telefono = s.telefono
where s.telefono = $1
limit 1;

name: Actualizar sesión con last_vacancies
query: update public.candidate_sessions set data = data || jsonb_build_object('last_vacancies', $1::jsonb), updated_at = now() where telefono = $2;

name: Guardar interés empresa
query:
insert into public.candidate_selected_vacancies (
  candidate_phone,
  vacancy_id,
  status,
  created_at
)
values (
  $1,
  $2::uuid,
  'interested',
  now()
)
on conflict (candidate_phone, vacancy_id) do update
set
  status = 'interested',
  created_at = now()
returning *;
